name: Ōnohara (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Ōnohara town emblem in white: a ring enclosing a stylised letter A with a pointed top.
history: Flag of the former town of Ōnohara in Kagawa Prefecture, dissolved on 2005-10-11. The municipal emblem was adopted on 14 May 1970.

features.role: Ōnohara town emblem — a ring enclosing a stylised letter A with a pointed top
